title: Aging in a spin glass with logarithmic correlations
summary: We consider a continuous-time random walk on the discrete two dimensional box, driven by the discrete Gaussian Free Field (DGFF) acting as potential: When at a vertex, the walk waits an exponentially distributed time with mean given by the exponential of the field times an inverse temperature parameter and then jumps to one of its neighbors uniformly at random.
